gaps: P0, P1: before the city’s founding (1703). P2: nothing usable (#1 is Canaletto’s Venice, held in the Hermitage). P5: only a dark 1958 dusk shot (#17), a street crowd (#16) and wartime aerial photos of outskirts (#18–21).
notes: #2 is dated ‘about 1802’ on Commons but shows Montferrand’s St. Isaac’s Cathedral (built 1818–58), so the date is wrong; skipped. #4 (Rijksmuseum chromolithograph, same view) is dated only ‘1800–1899’ and shows the finished cathedral; skipped as undated. #14 carries the printed mark ‘8808 P.Z.’ (Photoglob Zürich); the Commons record names no author.
